sources.locator: grep -Eni living spec|product spec|requirements doc|drift over docs and src

sources.locator: grep -Eni budget|usage_ledger|cost over src/no_human and docs/COST_LEVERS.md
sources.finding: Per-task token budgets, a usage ledger, per-task and window cost estimates and a Stats page exist; no billed-amount reconciliation.

sources.title: Bounded search: release, deploy, rollback, revert and delivery evidence
sources.locator: grep -rniE 'gh release|create_release|git tag|deploy|rollback|revert|gallery|preview|recording' over src/no_human (Python) and web/src, plus the nh command list in cli/commands.py
sources.finding: No release, deploy, rollback or revert command, endpoint or gate found. Matches are classifier vocabulary lists, commit-guard and scheduler comments about transaction rollback and reverted status writes, and a 'no automatic rollback' note on nh doctor --fix-walks. No live app preview or evidence gallery exists: 'preview' matches are text result previews of tool calls in the activity log, and 'recording' matches are the optional product telemetry's masked session replay, not delivery evidence.

sources.title: Scheduler pool sizing
sources.locator: pool_width_ceiling, clamp_pool_width, bounded_xdist_workers; api/app.py _workers_payload
sources.finding: The pool width is clamped to a CPU-derived ceiling (cpu_count // 3, minimum 2) when the server starts, and each task's pytest-xdist auto worker count is bounded to cpu // max_workers; Settings reports cpu_count and hardware_ceiling. No memory limit or live load check was found in these modules.

sources.title: Phone breakpoint in the web board
sources.locator: PHONE_QUERY (max-width: 640px), readIsPhone, subscribeIsPhone; styles.css @media rules
sources.finding: The web board has a phone layout keyed to a 640px media query shared between JavaScript and styles.css (pinned by useIsPhone.test.mjs); the board API stays unauthenticated and loopback-checked.

sources.title: Keyboard handling in the board
sources.locator: onKeyDown on task rows (Enter and Space); docs/UI_AUDIT.md B2 and M13 rows
sources.finding: Task rows and cards open the task drawer with Enter or Space, dialogs trap Tab focus and Escape closes slide-overs; the UI audit documents keyboard fixes. No list of keyboard shortcuts or command palette was found.

sources.title: Browser telemetry and session replay
sources.locator: file header comment: ALL CHANNELS ON, MASKED REPLAY; config.py telemetry block and TELEMETRY_CONSENT_QUESTION
sources.finding: With telemetry.enabled true (the default) the browser board loads PostHog with autocapture, pageview, dead-click, heatmap, performance and exception capture and masked session replay of the app's own interface; inputs are masked and operator-content elements carry a hand-applied ph-no-capture block. config.py states the onboarding consent step and Settings pane were removed and config.yaml telemetry.enabled false is the one opt-out.

sources.title: Usage insights: session replay, honestly stated
sources.locator: Usage insights section: Session replay, honestly stated; docs/security.md Usage telemetry bullet
sources.finding: The nine-event table covers only what the app sends via posthog.capture. Autocapture, dead clicks, heatmaps, web vitals and exceptions are collected alongside, and session replay is a masked-surface guarantee, not a claim that replay cannot capture content; it can capture pixels of anything not on the masked list. docs/security.md adds that the desktop update check cannot be disabled by NH_NO_UPDATE_CHECK or updates.enabled.

sources.title: Security model: outbound traffic
sources.locator: One GET to pypi.org per day; The desktop app checks GitHub Releases at startup
sources.finding: The desktop app checks GitHub Releases at startup once a day without downloading; neither NH_NO_UPDATE_CHECK nor updates.enabled reaches that path, so the only way to stop it is not to run the desktop app (documented as a defect).
